text:
Andrew Franz Architect, PLLC is an, award-winning New York City based architecture and design firm located in Flatiron with projects ranging from private houses and apartments to a variety of commercial and cultural facilities.
The studio is currently seeking a Senior Architectural Designer/Project Manager with a minimum of 7-10 years of professional experience to work on high-end residential design projects in NY, the surrounding states, Florida and the Bahamas, in a casual and collaborative work environment.
Candidates should have a strong background in design, a great understanding of the construction process of single family homes and possess excellent communication skills. The Senior Architectural Designer / Project Manager will work with the principal and a team to help manage projects from inception to completion and must be self-driven, motivated, and able to work with confidence through every stage of a project.
Qualifications:
- BArch or MArch degree.
- A minimum 7-10 years of professional experience
- Proficiency in Revit a must along with Adobe Suite, 3D modeling + rendering (Enscape & Rhino preferred) and strong Autocad and drafting skills.
- Experience managing residential jobs, including ground up wood and masonry construction
- Excellent organizational, presentation, and client management skills
- Strong design skills and a technical aptitude
- CD development experience and thorough knowledge of assembling CD, DOB and LPC sets
AFA is a collaborative work environment that invests in our staff’s development and growth. We value diversity and new ideas.
This is a full-time position with competitive compensation commensurate with a candidate’s experience and qualifications. We offer a wide range of employee benefits including health insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan, and paid holiday, vacation and personal days.
Applicants must reside in the New York City area. Applicants must possess valid working visa for 2 years, minimum.
If you think you are a good fit, please send a cover letter about why you would like to work with us along with a resume and a digital portfolio to [email protected].
Please put ‘Senior Architectural Designer / Project Manager/Your Name’ as the subject.
We regret that we will only be able to respond to qualified candidates who will be invited for an interview.
